title: Anoikis review-verdict findings
description: The one-shot artifact anoikis-reviewer writes when its verdict is the fix verdict, and graft --findings consumes: one entry per finding, scored on exactly the fields the engine's blocking threshold reads. It is written at Layout.ReviewFindings(reviewID), never at Layout.Findings() — that path is the effort's own durable findings register (findings-register.schema.json), a different artifact this one must never be mistaken for or written over.
